Don Tracy

Republican candidate for United States Senator, Illinois · Open seat

Don Tracy is the Republican nominee for Illinois's open U.S. Senate seat in the November 3, 2026 general election. He ran in the March 17, 2026 Republican primary. On October 20, 2026, he debated Democratic nominee Juliana Stratton at an event hosted by WTTW in Chicago.

Where Tracy stands

Cost of living
Says his top priority in the U.S. Senate would be lowering the cost of living and making life more affordable, and that he wants communities to be safer.
Energy and climate
Says carbon emissions should be reduced, including by supporting wind and solar "to a reasonable extent." Says nuclear energy and fossil fuels are an essential part of U.S. energy production.
Russia and Ukraine
Says he would not vote for a U.S.-Russia deal to end the war in Ukraine if it removed sanctions on Russia. Says war should always be a last resort for settling international disputes.
